row.title: COVERAGE-CITED-1: a statement is bound to the code it names, never to itself
row.body: 2026-11-20: 380 claim-like statements on source surfaces had no probe (coverage 5.5 percent, 67 Q-CLAIM-COVER items). scripts/bind_cited_claims.py registers each statement that cites a file that exists or a foundation module (and its step in checks.yml) with those as probes: 54 claims, coverage 42.8 percent, ratchet floor raised from 3.5 to 40 percent. 235 statements cite no code and stay unbound: generated data modules, code lines the patterns catch, and prose that needs a real probe or different words.

title: COVERAGE-CITED-1: a statement is bound to the code it names, never to itself
